name: application-statement-row
title: Statement Row
description: Bank-statement-style transaction table rows with a running balance column that accumulates from a real starting balance — distinct from transaction-row, which shows category icons and merchant metadata with no cumulative balance tracking.
useWhen: Displaying an account statement where each row's balance reflects all prior transactions.
You want the running balance computed live rather than hand-typed per row.
A simple tabular format fits better than icon-driven transaction cards.
avoidWhen: You need category icons and merchant-focused metadata with no balance column — use transaction-row instead.
You're confirming a single pending transaction — use transaction-confirm-sheet instead.
There's no starting balance to accumulate from — a plain transaction list is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: The table has a fixed max width; on narrow viewports it should be wrapped in a horizontally scrollable container by the consuming page.
accessibility: Semantic <table> markup with <th> headers lets assistive tech announce column meaning per cell.
Credit amounts are marked with both a '+' prefix and emerald color, never color alone.
The running balance is computed by accumulating each transaction in order, guaranteeing it never drifts from the underlying data.

variants.title: Statement row
variants.description: A 4-transaction statement starting from $2,450.00, with a running balance column computed cumulatively down to $4,122.05, on a light surface.
accessibility: Each row's balance is the real cumulative sum of the starting balance and all prior transaction amounts.

variants.title: Statement row (Dark)
variants.description: The same 4-transaction statement, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Credit amount color meets WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
